description: Backbone.js library version 1.6.1, providing models, collections, and event handling for JavaScript applications.

classes.name: Backbone.Events
classes.description: A module that provides event handling capabilities, allowing objects to bind, trigger, and unbind events.

classes.name: Backbone.Model
classes.description: Represents a data model with attributes, validation, and server synchronization.

classes.name: Backbone.Collection
classes.description: A collection of models, supporting add, remove, set, and server sync operations.

classes.name: Listening
classes.description: A helper class to manage event listening and cleanup.

classes.name: Backbone.View
classes.description: A JavaScript object representing a UI chunk, managing DOM elements, events, and rendering.

classes.name: CollectionIterator
classes.description: Implements JavaScript's Iterator protocol for Backbone.Collection, supporting for-of loops and interoperation.

classes.name: Backbone.Router
classes.description: Maps URLs to actions, manages route binding, and triggers events on route match.

methods.name: Backbone.noConflict
methods.description: Restores previous global Backbone variable and returns the Backbone object.

methods.name: Backbone.Events.on
methods.description: Binds a callback to an event.

methods.name: Backbone.Events.trigger
methods.description: Triggers all callbacks associated with an event.

methods.name: Backbone.Model.set
methods.description: Sets attributes on the model and triggers change events.

methods.name: Backbone.Model.fetch
methods.description: Fetches model data from the server.

methods.name: Backbone.Model.save
methods.description: Saves model data to the server.

methods.name: Backbone.Model.destroy
methods.description: Deletes the model on the server.

methods.name: Backbone.Collection.set
methods.description: Replaces the entire collection with a new list of models.

methods.name: Backbone.sync
methods.description: Overrides default persistence method; performs RESTful Ajax requests based on method type.

methods.name: Backbone.ajax
methods.description: Default Ajax implementation proxying to jQuery.

methods.name: Router.route
methods.description: Binds a route pattern to a callback, triggers route events.

methods.name: Router.navigate
methods.description: Changes URL fragment and updates history.
